Name: (AT) ErikaCAT's Pride Furniture
Author: ErikaCAT
Description:
Have you ever wished you had gayer house? I know I have so I spent 3 entire days making pride themed furniture because I have no life and this is all I'll ever need. Yes I know it isn't pride month, no I don't care [s]because I'm impatient and I just started making mods like a month ago or something[/s]


List of furniture items I made new textures for:
[list]
[*]Brick Fireplace
[*]Stone Fireplace
[*]Iridium Fireplace
[*]Large Green Rug
[*]Clouds Banner
[/list]
Might make more

How to install and use:

1. Download the file and Alternative Textures
2. Extract the files and put in the mods folder for Stardew Valley
3. Start the game and go to Robin's shop to buy the Paint Bucket
4. Use the Paint Bucket on the listed furniture items above and select which texture you want for them
5. Enjoy your new and improved gayified furniture :)

Note: I didn't really know how to make the pi symbol in the polyamorous flag on the fireplaces so I just made it a tiny heart
